windows: whole plus every fixed16000 samples truncated at100480, plus construction intervals[0,16000),[16000,64000),[64000,65280),[65280,84496),[84496,100480)
metrics: math.fsum energy/rms/peak; gain-sensitive error=sum((y-near)^2)/sum(near^2) in dB; projection gain=sum(y*near)/sum(near^2); diagnostic projection SI-SDR=sum((gain*near)^2)/sum((y-gain*near)^2), uncentered, no epsilon/floor, null if zero numerator or denominator. Label noncanonical, not pure speech distortion; y is mixed processed output
source_checks: D1 artifact manifest every consumed member; plain/observed/original finalPCM and metrics bytes same; observer no errors,629frames,offsets exact; source ZIP hash and admitted near exact. No DSP/new alignment/model execution
gate_description: read fixed originalcontrol.csv and report counts/EMA and instant ratios for source-waveform-nonzero frames; never call this human VAD truth, detector accuracy or adaptation count
reference_constraints: raw engineering near is not passed through HPF/BF; filtering/phase/spatial effects confound cross-stage error, and scalar projection is not physical source decomposition. NS stage includes joint spectral RES. Fixed160 postNS shift is algorithmic block latency, not acoustic delay. No lag fit, gain normalization of output, tail flush or metric threshold selection
acceptance: All identity/schema/equality/finite/length checks mandatory; output all windows, zero near energy metrics null; compare independent recomputation before interpreting. Descriptive result only, no improvement threshold or promotion
